name: agg Analytics
author: Mateusz Worotyński <worotyns@icloud.com>
description: Cookieless, self-hosted analytics and insights with agg: page views, visitors, top pages, referrers and most read articles. Paste your agg host and pk_ site key.

messageInOptions.text: Create a site in your agg server (Website analytics or Blog / publisher preset), then paste the server address and the site key (pk_…) from Settings → Install. Nothing is sent in Preview Mode unless you enable it below.

config.name: host
config.label: agg server address
config.note: Where your agg server runs, e.g. https://agg.example.com. https:// is added when missing.

config.name: siteKey
config.label: Site key
config.note: The public site key, starting with pk_. It is safe to publish: it only allows sending events.

config.name: trackArticles
config.label: Track article reads
config.note: Sends article_read with { article, title, section, author } on post pages once the reader scrolled far enough or stayed long enough. Feeds the Most read articles and Readers per section aggregates of the Blog / publisher preset. The section is the post's main tag. Your theme must output the footer custom code (all official themes do).

config.name: readSeconds
config.label: Read after (seconds on the page)
config.note: Counted only while the tab is visible. 0 disables the time rule.

config.name: readScroll
config.label: Read after scrolling (% of the page)
config.note: Whichever rule is met first counts the read. 0 disables the scroll rule.

config.name: trackOutbound
config.label: Track outbound link clicks
config.note: Sends outbound_click with { host, url } when a visitor follows a link to another site. Add an aggregate grouped by props.host to see where readers go.

config.name: previewMode
config.label: Send events in Preview Mode
config.note: Only for checking the setup: previews would otherwise count as real visits.

config.name: cookieBannerIntegration
config.label: Wait for consent from the Publii Cookie Banner
config.note: agg sets no cookies and stores only a random visitor id in localStorage, so many sites do not need consent for it. Enable this to load agg only after the visitor accepts the cookie group below.

config.name: cookieBannerGroup
config.label: Cookie Group ID
config.note: The Cookie Group ID from Site Settings → Privacy (GDPR), e.g. analytics. See the Publii documentation.
